pages.text: Stores spare oxygen for a sealed room. It makes none.

pages.title: Capacity
pages.text: $(bold)1,200 player-seconds$(): one player for 20 minutes.$(br2)Ten canister units make one player-second.

pages.title: Rates
pages.text: Fills from up to $(bold)4$() spare units and delivers up to $(bold)8$() per second. Empty to full: five minutes at 4 spare.$(br2)Values are configurable.

pages.title: Shared Budget
pages.text: Breathing and flames come first. Reservoirs cover a shortfall, up to their output and contents.
Only spare production refills reservoirs, Core canisters, EVA reserves and airlock reserves, shared fairly.$(br2)Reservoir output can't recharge storage.
More reservoirs add capacity and output to their own pool. They can't join separate rooms or pressurize one.

pages.title: Shutoff
pages.text: A breach shuts the valve; contents stay inside. Unknown or unloaded rooms pause it.$(br2)After resealing it reconnects once normal room gas returns.

pages.title: Moving It
pages.text: Mine it with a pickaxe to keep its exact contents. $(danger)An explosion destroys both.$()$(br2)Front bars show contents; amber means shutoff or discharging.
Six iron, two copper, one glass. Crafted empty.$(br2)$(flavor)Do not open the vessel to check whether it is full.$()
